title: Microsoft Clipchamp: improved audio for Copilot AI-generated videos
summary: The scope section says no prerequisites are stated, although the roadmap explicitly names a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence. go to the Users > Active users page.

claims.claim: Mixed licensing reflects the roadmap's Copilot licence statement and Learn's usage-based listing, without establishing whether the licence and credits are both required.
claims.quote:
